reply_text: `cc05e83` (the pin) compiles `Array.extract`; `84dfff6` doesn't. Because the tracker still shows an old pass for it, it has been counted as compiled ever since. Four parallel probes are now narrowing it down to a single merge. Separately, the drop for `Array.extract.loop` is the reclassification codex-18 recommended, which codex-17 applied.
